details:
This update for podofo fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2018-8002: infinite loop vulnerability in ParseFileComplete() (bsc#1084891).
- CVE-2020-18971: stack-based buffer overflow in src/base/PdfDictionary.cpp (bsc#1190178).
- CVE-2021-30470: uncontrolled recursive call of funtions in src/base/PdfTokenizer.cpp can lead to a stack overflow
  (bsc#1186588).
- CVE-2021-30471: uncontrolled recursive call in PdfNamesTree:AddToDictionary function in
  src/podofo/doc/PdfNamesTree.cpp (bsc#1184645).
